summary: Iteration 8, frontend only, server build /js/toolbar.min.js, speechSynthesis mocked, pages / and /test-modal.html, desktop 1920x1080 and Pixel 5 touch context. PASS: (A) the empty-area tap fix works. On Pixel 5: tap #t1 gives on/1, tap empty gives suspended, re-tap #t1 at <250 ms gives on/2. The variant 'speech ended, then empty tap, then re-tap' also speaks again. (B) The :link state is now correct. Homepage with darkblue_orange_brown alone and with reinforcedContrasts: 'Télécharger le .xpi' and '.xpi Android' are cplus-link-on-light, darkblue on orange rgb(255,121,0), 5.82:1. 'les issues GitHub du projet' is on-light, darkblue on the real blended background rgb(255,242,230), 13.91:1. Across all 11 links the minimum is 5.15:1. On test-modal.html #dark-link stays on-dark, rgb(114,114,255) on #111, 5.01:1. The normal link is darkblue on white, 15.3:1. (C) black_green + yellow_orange_blue: link yellow 4.78, visited white 5.14, hover rgb(255,246,229) 4.79, all >= 4.5 against the real green (was 1.2 and 2.6). ivory_black + darkblue_orange_brown: link rgb(114,114,255) 5.57, visited rgb(209,74,74) 4.79, hover orange 10.63. black_ivory + lightblue_orange_lightgreen: link rgb(46,126,153) 4.56, visited rgb(20,132,20) 4.80, hover rgb(153,99,0) 5.03. Reset (noModifications) removes all classes and the adaptive style. NON-REGRESSIONS PASS: masks (desktop 500/500, touch 324/324, pointer-events none, elementFromPoint gives #dialog-ok, #cp filled and #dialog-ok clicked on both, pointermove and tap move the band, reset removes the masks); i18n first visit (title 'Unfold Comfort+', no pageerror); desktop and mobile tooltips; click and re-click, other text, Esc, right click, Tab focus reads, Enter on the link being read activates (#ancre), sentence with a link read in full, link 1st click reads and 2nd activates, accordion (1st tap reads + focus with 0 toggles, 2nd toggles), button (1st 0, 2nd 1); palette opens in one click with 0 utterances; text reinforcement (#aaa becomes #000, #ff9966 becomes rgb(204,68,0) keeping its hue, #555 on #222 becomes #fff, #777 on rgba(0,0,0,.85) becomes #fff, page backgrounds unchanged, exact restore). FAIL: (1) the visited and hover states of links are still adjusted against the theme or page reference background (white/black), not against each link's own background. On the orange CTAs visited is brown at 2.69:1 and hover is rgb(153,99,0) at 1.93:1 (confirmed visually with a real hover). #dark-link visited on #111 is rgb(209,74,74) at 4.31:1. (2) 15 palette cycles (mode, validate, settings, back, reload) each raise a JS error 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading split)' in BtnSettingComponent.setTitle via ColorReadComponent, 60 errors in 15 cycles. Root cause: a missing comma in color-read.component.ts.

ui_bugs.component: ColorContrastService.buildAdaptiveLinksStyle / applyAdaptiveLinkColor (visited and hover states on non-reference backgrounds)
ui_bugs.issue: Only two global variant sets exist: 'light', computed against white (or the light theme background), and 'dark', computed against black (or the dark theme background). The class is now picked correctly per link, but a link on a mid-tone background gets variants computed for white or black. Homepage, darkblue_orange_brown alone or reinforcedContrasts: CTA 'Télécharger le .xpi' on rgb(255,121,0) has :link darkblue 5.82 OK, :visited brown 2.69 FAIL and :hover rgb(153,99,0) 1.93 FAIL. It is even lower against hover:bg-confort-orange-dark, and the text is visibly unreadable when hovered. test-modal #dark-link on #111: :visited rgb(209,74,74) is 4.31 FAIL, because it was adjusted against #000 and not #111. Peach banner: hover is 4.61, borderline OK.

values: DEFAULT_VALUE + "splitSyllables_word,..." has no comma after DEFAULT_VALUE, so the first value becomes 'noModificationssplitSyllables_word'. getValueLabel then returns undefined and content.split(' — ') throws a TypeError in BtnSettingComponent.setTitle every time the settings page that contains Colour reading is rendered (after validate, on settings, back and reload). 60 pageerrors in 15 cycles. This is upstream code (commit 973cbb7a) and also present in toolbar.min.js. Fix: DEFAULT_VALUE + ',' + 'splitSyllables_word,...' and add a guard (content?.split).

issues: The visited (#fff) and hover (rgb(255,246,229)) links are almost identical (about 1.07:1 between them). On #008000, only colours with luminance >= 0.87 reach 4.5:1, so you cannot tell the states apart by colour. Consider a non-colour cue (underline style or weight) for hover/visited on this theme.

action_items: MEDIUM: adaptive links. Compute the visited and hover variants (and ideally :link too) against the link's real blended background, not only the white/black/theme reference. For example, set per-link CSS custom properties (--cplus-link, --cplus-visited, --cplus-hover) from reinforceColor(color, getBlendedBackground(link)), or group links by background. Re-check: homepage orange CTAs (visited 2.69, hover 1.93 now) and #dark-link on #111 (visited 4.31 now).

MEDIUM: color-read.component.ts. Add the missing comma after DEFAULT_VALUE in activesValues.values and rebuild toolbar.min.js. Optionally guard content in BtnSettingComponent.setTitle. This removes the 'reading split' pageerror raised on every settings render.
LOW: black_green. Make visited and hover distinguishable by something other than colour.
critical_code_review_comments: read-aloud onActivationGesture: the early return with stopSpeech(false) when !speakTarget is correct and verified.

isDarkBackground now compares contrast with white against contrast with black: correct. getBlendedBackground composites alpha layers properly (the peach banner gives 255,242,230). If no opaque ancestor exists, white is assumed; under a dark colour theme, the theme background would be more accurate.
buildAdaptiveLinksStyle uses only 2 global variant sets, so per-background accuracy is still lost for visited and hover (see ui_bugs).
The text reinforcement (reinforceColor) also uses getBlendedBackground; it worked correctly on rgba(0,0,0,.85).
updated_files: /app/tests/links_probe8.js (new test helper only, no source changes)

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (A, B on :link, C and all non-regressions pass; visited/hover contrast on mid-tone backgrounds fails; JS error in palette cycles from ColorRead)

seed_data_creation: None. Test DOM injected at runtime (inject.js plus inline text-contrast samples).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reset values must be 'noModifications' (DEFAULT_VALUE), NOT 'default'. 'default' is parsed as a palette or theme. links_probe8.js (evaluate with an optional selector argument) composites alpha backgrounds and parses style#...adaptive... to give link/visited/hover ratios per link. Toolbar: shadowRoot of cplus-app-root; on first visit it opens on #select-mode-zone (radios are #facileplus, #visionplus...), and the 'Validate this mode' button is found by text. Then #settings-btn and #prev-toolbar. #change-mode-btn exists only on the home page. Mask ids: cplus-mask-guide__top-elt / bottom-elt; readingGuideServiceInstance.setReadingMaskGuide('maskGuide'). The Pixel 5 context is created via page.context.browser.new_context(has_touch, is_mobile).
